Selo.home.hero.title: A bookstore-publisher for people who read with their whole body.
Selo.home.hero.description: Selo Libertaria brings together books, cultural projects, salons, and author-led publishing inside one experience of reading, presence, and desire.
Selo.home.hero.supportingLine: Printed books, sonic editions, live gatherings, and cultural projects.
Selo.home.hero.featureTitle: A hybrid home where catalogue, cultural programming, and authorial context meet without friction.
Selo.home.hero.featureBody: A hybrid home where catalogue, cultural programming, and authorial context meet without friction.
Selo.home.hero.featureQuote: Reading can also be a way of igniting presence.
Selo.home.featured.title: Books to enter this universe through reading.
Selo.home.manifesto.title: Literature to set language, city, and imagination on fire.
Selo.home.manifesto.body: Between publications, live encounters, and performance, Selo Libertaria builds an authorial catalogue for adults where the book operates as work, gesture, and cultural presence at once.
Selo.home.agenda.title: Upcoming encounters, readings, and public appearances from the selo.
Selo.home.projects.title: A practice that moves through books, stage, and formation.
Selo.home.immersive.quote: Reading can also be a way of igniting presence.
Selo.home.author.title: Natalia Nolli Sasso and the wider orbit of Selo Libertaria
Selo.home.author.body: Books remain at the center, but the catalogue grows in dialogue with public programs, workshops, salons, and collaborative cultural work.
Selo.home.author.secondaryBody: The new site should let readers move naturally from a title to the artistic and cultural context that surrounds it.
Selo.home.community.title: Follow the next books, salons, and cultural projects.
Selo.home.community.body: Receive updates, follow the networks, and get in touch for invitations, partnerships, and programming.
Selo.footer.description: Independent books, performances, workshops, and cultural programming gathered inside one editorial site.
Selo.footer.newsletterTitle: Join the Selo Libertaria mailing list
Selo.about.heroTitle: An editorial site shaped by books, performance, and cultural programming.
Selo.about.heroBody: The site is not only a place to buy books. It is also the public face of an author-led publishing and cultural practice.
Selo.about.publishingBody: The catalogue should keep product detail pages, pricing, variants, cart, and checkout intact while gaining sharper editorial framing around each release.
Selo.about.programmingTitle: Events extend the life of the catalogue.
Selo.about.programmingBody: Readings, labs, festivals, and performances should live beside the shop so visitors understand the selo as a cultural platform instead of a product list alone.
Selo.about.directionBody: The site should feel intentionally curated, literary, and intimate without sacrificing clarity, speed, or the reliability expected from an e-commerce flow.
Selo.about.sectionTitle: An editorial site shaped by books, performance, and cultural programming.
Selo.about.sectionBody: Selo Libertaria is an author-driven publishing and cultural platform that brings together printed books, sonic releases, workshops, events, and long-form projects. Instead of splitting commerce from institutional content, the site should let readers move naturally from discovering a title to understanding the artistic and cultural context around it.
Selo.about.sectionExtended: At its center is the work of Natalia Nolli Sasso and the wider orbit of collaborators, venues, and cultural initiatives that support the selo. The site needs to hold both functions at once: a reliable place to buy books and a clear stage for projects, events, and editorial identity.
Selo.about.whyTitle: The commercial layer and the cultural layer should reinforce each other.
Selo.about.whyBody: Read a book, discover a program, enter an archive, and return to the catalogue. The experience should feel like one ecosystem instead of parallel disconnected pages.
Selo.about.coreTitle: An adult bookstore can be warm, literary, and sensual without becoming visually obvious.
Selo.events.metadataDescription: Archive and live program for author events, readings, and public-facing activities.
Selo.events.heroTitle: Public programming lives next to the catalogue.
Selo.events.heroBody: Readings, workshops, and archive material should help visitors understand the catalogue as part of a wider cultural practice, not as isolated products.
Selo.events.principleTitle: The page should remain strong even when there is no future schedule to highlight.
Selo.events.principleBody: If there are upcoming dates, they should be highlighted first. If not, the page still works as a visual archive of the selo's author events and cultural trajectory.
Selo.projects.metadataDescription: Portfolio of workshops, festivals, readings, and cultural projects connected to Selo Libertaria.
Selo.projects.heroTitle: Cultural projects that expand the catalogue.
Selo.projects.heroBody: Selo Libertaria moves through workshops, festivals, launches, and recurring reading programs. This page brings those initiatives into the same ecosystem as the store.
Selo.sarau.metadataDescription: Editorial and event context for the Sarau Safado initiative inside Selo Libertaria.
Selo.sarau.whyBody: In the merged site, Sarau Safado should not feel like a detached event flyer. It should work as a flagship program that connects the author, the books, and the live cultural field.
Selo.sarau.continueBody: Readers can move from Sarau Safado into the broader project archive, event programming, or directly into the catalogue without leaving the same product language behind.
Selo.sarau.heroTitle: A recurring erotic-literature ritual inside the selo.
Selo.sarau.heroBody: A recurring initiative dedicated to erotic literatures, readings, performances, and encounters around desire, authorship, and public listening.
Selo.contact.metadataDescription: Reach Selo Libertaria for books, partnerships, events, workshops, and press.
Selo.contact.title: Talk to the selo about books, invitations, partnerships, and programming.
Selo.contact.description: Use this space for book inquiries, cultural invitations, workshops, press, collaborations, or programming conversations.
Selo.contact.formDescription: We will route your note to the right path inside books, events, partnerships, or support.
Selo.contact.directDescription: Reach the selo through the main editorial and social touchpoints.
Selo.contact.pathsDescription: Move quickly between catalogue, programming, and institutional pages.
Selo.faq.description: Questions about buying books, delivery, custom work, or how to reach the selo.
Selo.catalogue.description: Books, editions, and authorial releases presented as a curated shelf instead of a generic product grid.
Selo.search.description: Search results should feel like a curated shelf, even when the answer is narrow or empty.
Selo.product.editorialTitle: Every title sits inside a wider field of reading, performance, and cultural programming.
Selo.product.editorialBody: This site keeps the purchase flow direct, but the books are not presented as isolated objects. They belong to the same ecosystem as readings, workshops, live programs, and the authorial curation that shapes the selo.
Selo.product.eventsBody: See how the catalogue extends into public programming.
Selo.product.projectsBody: Explore the cultural projects that expand the work around the books.
Selo.product.sarauBody: Enter the recurring erotic-literature ritual inside the selo.

/faq.page.title: Frequently asked questions
/faq.page.items.payment.question: Which payment methods does the store accept?
/faq.page.items.payment.answer: Payments are processed by Stripe and can include cards and compatible wallets shown during checkout.
/faq.page.items.tracking.question: How do I track my order?
/faq.page.items.tracking.answer: Whenever the status changes, the store may send updates by email according to the information registered in your account.
/faq.page.items.customWork.question: Does the store offer custom orders?
/faq.page.items.customWork.answer: Yes. Depending on the product or project, production timelines and alignment may be required before shipping.
/faq.page.items.contact.question: How do I get in touch about events, art, or special projects?
/faq.page.items.contact.answer: Use the contact page or the brand's official channels to talk about murals, activations, and commissions.

/privacy.page.title: Privacy
/privacy.page.intro: This page summarizes how the store handles data submitted by customers through registrations, forms, and orders.
/privacy.page.sections.collectedData.bod: We may store information provided during checkout, login, and contact forms to process purchases, respond to requests, and track orders.
Data may be used for support, payment confirmation, order communication, fraud prevention, and store experience improvements.
/privacy.page.sections.contact.title: 3. Contact
